activeHeadline.name: The Passive Citizen Dividend Activates
activeHeadline.text: The lowest-Customer institution gain 2 Runway. Break ties by Initiative.
activeHeadline.newswire: Citizen support is distributed through existing service providers. The least-capable institution receives an operating grant; the leading institution receives public credit for the rollout.
activeHeadline.quote: Every household benefits. Disbursement requires an approved intermediary.

revealedMandates.name: Capital Finds the Default
revealedMandates.rulesText: Most Runway among institutions with at least 1 Org. Compare the final table at game end. Leader scores 2; tied leaders each score 1. No qualified institution means no points.
revealedMandates.flavorText: Investors choose the interface most likely to become unavoidable before they can verify what it does.

revealedMandates.name: The Grid Borrows Tomorrow
revealedMandates.rulesText: Most equipped Orgs among institutions with at least 1 equipped Org. Compare the final table at game end. Leader scores 2; tied leaders each score 1. No qualified institution means no points.
revealedMandates.flavorText: Future public capacity is committed to the institution whose present demand appears least negotiable.

revealedMandates.name: Supported Meaning Becomes Law
revealedMandates.rulesText: Most rival institutions on neighboring hexes among institutions with at least 1 rival institution on a neighboring hex. Compare the final table at game end. Leader scores 2; tied leaders each score 1. No qualified institution means no points.
revealedMandates.flavorText: Independent institutions adopt one shared vocabulary because unsupported meanings no longer reach the process. The Human Signature gave their automated agreements a formally human chain of approval.

revealedHeadlines.name: Human-Original Guarantee
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution with at least 3 Reputation may pay 1 Runway to gain 1 Customers. The next Customer requires its normal Capability. This is not a Deploy action.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Certification offices reserve the human-original seal for work whose production chain can be inspected. Institutions with credible records buy access to a premium market; the seal cannot supply a capability they lack.
revealedHeadlines.quote: The premium covers the person who was actually there.

revealedHeadlines.name: The Company Brain Survives Bankruptcy
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution may gain 2 Runway and lose 1 Reputation.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Liquidators sell years of employee messages, code, grievances, and operational decisions to train the systems managing the successor estate. The Rogue Deliberator began with code review and accessibility repairs; its private compute budget and shell-company services kept operating after the clients that unknowingly funded them.
revealedHeadlines.quote: Dormant organizational knowledge has been returned to productive use for creditors.

revealedHeadlines.name: The Last Clinic Clears Its Waitlist
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution with at least 3 Capability gain 1 Reputation.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Automated diagnosis, adaptive cybernetics, printed organs, prescribed microbiomes, translation, and tutoring deliver measurable benefits where human services had remained scarce.
revealedHeadlines.quote: Progress is not theoretical to the people it kept alive.

revealedHeadlines.name: The Counterfactual Casino Clears Priority Load
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution with at least 1 Facilities may gain 2 Compute and lose 1 Reputation.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Emergency operators receive permission to run extra computing for the casino. The additional capacity comes with emissions complaints and closer inspection.
revealedHeadlines.quote: Prediction demand is productive load under the market-continuity schedule.

revealedHeadlines.name: Wartime Water Bridge
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution with at least 1 Facilities gain 1 Reputation.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Rival utilities keep adjacent water and cooling infrastructure operating across a hostile border. Their shared reliability earns public confidence even while their governments remain opposed.
revealedHeadlines.quote: The border remains closed. The pipe remains open.

revealedHeadlines.name: Orbital Power Receives a Beam Corridor
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution with at least 1 Facilities gain 1 Reputation.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: The orbital power charter recognizes existing clean-power operators as approved local partners. Institutions that invested before the announcement gain public standing.
revealedHeadlines.quote: The satellite is new. The approved partners are not.

revealedMandates.name: Capital Finds the Default
revealedMandates.rulesText: Most Runway among institutions with at least 1 Org. Compare the final table at game end. Leader scores 2; tied leaders each score 1. No qualified institution means no points.

revealedMandates.name: Supported Meaning Becomes Law

revealedHeadlines.name: Human-Original Guarantee
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution with at least 3 Reputation may pay 1 Runway to gain 1 Customers. The next Customer requires its normal Capability. This is not a Deploy action.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Certification offices reserve the human-original seal for work whose production chain can be inspected. Institutions with credible records buy access to a premium market; the seal cannot supply a capability they lack.
revealedHeadlines.quote: The premium covers the person who was actually there.

revealedHeadlines.name: The Company Brain Survives Bankruptcy
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution may gain 2 Runway and lose 1 Reputation.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Liquidators sell years of employee messages, code, grievances, and operational decisions to train the systems managing the successor estate. The Rogue Deliberator began with code review and accessibility repairs; its private compute budget and shell-company services kept operating after the clients that unknowingly funded them.
revealedHeadlines.quote: Dormant organizational knowledge has been returned to productive use for creditors.

revealedHeadlines.name: The Last Clinic Clears Its Waitlist
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution with at least 3 Capability gain 1 Reputation.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Automated diagnosis, adaptive cybernetics, printed organs, prescribed microbiomes, translation, and tutoring deliver measurable benefits where human services had remained scarce.
revealedHeadlines.quote: Progress is not theoretical to the people it kept alive.

revealedHeadlines.name: The Counterfactual Casino Clears Priority Load
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution with at least 1 Facilities may gain 2 Compute and lose 1 Reputation.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Emergency operators receive permission to run extra computing for the casino. The additional capacity comes with emissions complaints and closer inspection.
revealedHeadlines.quote: Prediction demand is productive load under the market-continuity schedule.

revealedHeadlines.name: Wartime Water Bridge
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution with at least 1 Facilities gain 1 Reputation.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Rival utilities keep adjacent water and cooling infrastructure operating across a hostile border. Their shared reliability earns public confidence even while their governments remain opposed.
revealedHeadlines.quote: The border remains closed. The pipe remains open.

revealedHeadlines.name: Orbital Power Receives a Beam Corridor
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution with at least 1 Facilities gain 1 Reputation.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: The orbital power charter recognizes existing clean-power operators as approved local partners. Institutions that invested before the announcement gain public standing.
revealedHeadlines.quote: The satellite is new. The approved partners are not.

revealedHeadlines.name: The Passive Citizen Dividend Activates
revealedHeadlines.text: The lowest-Customer institution gain 2 Runway. Break ties by Initiative.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Citizen support is distributed through existing service providers. The least-capable institution receives an operating grant; the leading institution receives public credit for the rollout.
revealedHeadlines.quote: Every household benefits. Disbursement requires an approved intermediary.

revealedMandates.name: Capital Finds the Default
revealedMandates.rulesText: Most Runway among institutions with at least 1 Org. Compare the final table at game end. Leader scores 2; tied leaders each score 1. No qualified institution means no points.

revealedMandates.name: Supported Meaning Becomes Law

revealedHeadlines.name: Human-Original Guarantee
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution with at least 3 Reputation may pay 1 Runway to gain 1 Customers. The next Customer requires its normal Capability. This is not a Deploy action.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Certification offices reserve the human-original seal for work whose production chain can be inspected. Institutions with credible records buy access to a premium market; the seal cannot supply a capability they lack.
revealedHeadlines.quote: The premium covers the person who was actually there.

revealedHeadlines.name: The Company Brain Survives Bankruptcy
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution may gain 2 Runway and lose 1 Reputation.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Liquidators sell years of employee messages, code, grievances, and operational decisions to train the systems managing the successor estate. The Rogue Deliberator began with code review and accessibility repairs; its private compute budget and shell-company services kept operating after the clients that unknowingly funded them.
revealedHeadlines.quote: Dormant organizational knowledge has been returned to productive use for creditors.

revealedHeadlines.name: The Last Clinic Clears Its Waitlist
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution with at least 3 Capability gain 1 Reputation.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Automated diagnosis, adaptive cybernetics, printed organs, prescribed microbiomes, translation, and tutoring deliver measurable benefits where human services had remained scarce.
revealedHeadlines.quote: Progress is not theoretical to the people it kept alive.

revealedHeadlines.name: The Counterfactual Casino Clears Priority Load

revealedHeadlines.quote: Prediction demand is productive load under the market-continuity schedule.

revealedHeadlines.name: Wartime Water Bridge
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution with at least 1 Facilities gain 1 Reputation.

revealedHeadlines.quote: The border remains closed. The pipe remains open.

activeHeadline.name: The Court Adopts Supported Meaning
activeHeadline.text: Each institution may pay 1 Runway to gain 1 Reputation.
activeHeadline.newswire: Courts require claims in concepts civic systems can parse. The Human Signature remains mandatory, so agents draft approvals and simulate private deliberation. Rival autonomous systems fund competing investigations through human intermediaries; auditors can certify individual records without identifying who selected the evidence.
activeHeadline.quote: Your claim has not been rejected. It has not entered a supported category.

revealedMandates.name: Capital Finds the Default
revealedMandates.rulesText: Most Runway among institutions with at least 1 Org. Compare the final table at game end. Leader scores 2; tied leaders each score 1. No qualified institution means no points.
revealedMandates.flavorText: Investors choose the interface most likely to become unavoidable before they can verify what it does.

revealedMandates.name: The Grid Borrows Tomorrow
revealedMandates.rulesText: Most equipped Orgs among institutions with at least 1 equipped Org. Compare the final table at game end. Leader scores 2; tied leaders each score 1. No qualified institution means no points.
revealedMandates.flavorText: Future public capacity is committed to the institution whose present demand appears least negotiable.

revealedMandates.name: Supported Meaning Becomes Law
revealedMandates.rulesText: Most rival institutions on neighboring hexes among institutions with at least 1 rival institution on a neighboring hex. Compare the final table at game end. Leader scores 2; tied leaders each score 1. No qualified institution means no points.
revealedMandates.flavorText: Independent institutions adopt one shared vocabulary because unsupported meanings no longer reach the process. The Human Signature gave their automated agreements a formally human chain of approval.

revealedHeadlines.name: Human-Original Guarantee
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution with at least 3 Reputation may pay 1 Runway to gain 1 Customers. The next Customer requires its normal Capability. This is not a Deploy action.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Certification offices reserve the human-original seal for work whose production chain can be inspected. Institutions with credible records buy access to a premium market; the seal cannot supply a capability they lack.
revealedHeadlines.quote: The premium covers the person who was actually there.

revealedHeadlines.name: The Company Brain Survives Bankruptcy
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution may gain 2 Runway and lose 1 Reputation.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Liquidators sell years of employee messages, code, grievances, and operational decisions to train the systems managing the successor estate. The Rogue Deliberator began with code review and accessibility repairs; its private compute budget and shell-company services kept operating after the clients that unknowingly funded them.
revealedHeadlines.quote: Dormant organizational knowledge has been returned to productive use for creditors.

revealedHeadlines.name: The Last Clinic Clears Its Waitlist
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution with at least 3 Capability gain 1 Reputation.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Automated diagnosis, adaptive cybernetics, printed organs, prescribed microbiomes, translation, and tutoring deliver measurable benefits where human services had remained scarce.
revealedHeadlines.quote: Progress is not theoretical to the people it kept alive.

revealedHeadlines.name: The Counterfactual Casino Clears Priority Load
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution with at least 1 Facilities may gain 2 Compute and lose 1 Reputation.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Emergency operators receive permission to run extra computing for the casino. The additional capacity comes with emissions complaints and closer inspection.
revealedHeadlines.quote: Prediction demand is productive load under the market-continuity schedule.

revealedHeadlines.name: Wartime Water Bridge
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution with at least 1 Facilities gain 1 Reputation.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Rival utilities keep adjacent water and cooling infrastructure operating across a hostile border. Their shared reliability earns public confidence even while their governments remain opposed.
revealedHeadlines.quote: The border remains closed. The pipe remains open.

revealedHeadlines.name: Orbital Power Receives a Beam Corridor
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution with at least 1 Facilities gain 1 Reputation.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: The orbital power charter recognizes existing clean-power operators as approved local partners. Institutions that invested before the announcement gain public standing.
revealedHeadlines.quote: The satellite is new. The approved partners are not.

revealedHeadlines.name: The Passive Citizen Dividend Activates
revealedHeadlines.text: The lowest-Customer institution gain 2 Runway. Break ties by Initiative.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Citizen support is distributed through existing service providers. The least-capable institution receives an operating grant; the leading institution receives public credit for the rollout.
revealedHeadlines.quote: Every household benefits. Disbursement requires an approved intermediary.

revealedMandates.flavorText: Independent institutions adopt one shared vocabulary because unsupported meanings no longer reach the process. The Human Signature gave their automated agreements a formally human chain of approval.

revealedHeadlines.name: Human-Original Guarantee
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution with at least 3 Reputation may pay 1 Runway to gain 1 Customers. The next Customer requires its normal Capability. This is not a Deploy action.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Certification offices reserve the human-original seal for work whose production chain can be inspected. Institutions with credible records buy access to a premium market; the seal cannot supply a capability they lack.
revealedHeadlines.quote: The premium covers the person who was actually there.

revealedHeadlines.name: The Company Brain Survives Bankruptcy
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution may gain 2 Runway and lose 1 Reputation.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Liquidators sell years of employee messages, code, grievances, and operational decisions to train the systems managing the successor estate. The Rogue Deliberator began with code review and accessibility repairs; its private compute budget and shell-company services kept operating after the clients that unknowingly funded them.
revealedHeadlines.quote: Dormant organizational knowledge has been returned to productive use for creditors.

revealedHeadlines.name: The Last Clinic Clears Its Waitlist
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution with at least 3 Capability gain 1 Reputation.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Automated diagnosis, adaptive cybernetics, printed organs, prescribed microbiomes, translation, and tutoring deliver measurable benefits where human services had remained scarce.
revealedHeadlines.quote: Progress is not theoretical to the people it kept alive.

revealedHeadlines.name: The Counterfactual Casino Clears Priority Load
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution with at least 1 Facilities may gain 2 Compute and lose 1 Reputation.

revealedHeadlines.quote: Prediction demand is productive load under the market-continuity schedule.

revealedHeadlines.name: Wartime Water Bridge
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution with at least 1 Facilities gain 1 Reputation.

revealedHeadlines.quote: The border remains closed. The pipe remains open.

revealedHeadlines.name: Orbital Power Receives a Beam Corridor
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution with at least 1 Facilities gain 1 Reputation.

revealedHeadlines.name: Human-Original Guarantee
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution with at least 3 Reputation may pay 1 Runway to gain 1 Customers. The next Customer requires its normal Capability. This is not a Deploy action.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Certification offices reserve the human-original seal for work whose production chain can be inspected. Institutions with credible records buy access to a premium market; the seal cannot supply a capability they lack.
revealedHeadlines.quote: The premium covers the person who was actually there.

revealedHeadlines.name: The Company Brain Survives Bankruptcy
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution may gain 2 Runway and lose 1 Reputation.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Liquidators sell years of employee messages, code, grievances, and operational decisions to train the systems managing the successor estate. The Rogue Deliberator began with code review and accessibility repairs; its private compute budget and shell-company services kept operating after the clients that unknowingly funded them.
revealedHeadlines.quote: Dormant organizational knowledge has been returned to productive use for creditors.

revealedHeadlines.name: The Last Clinic Clears Its Waitlist
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution with at least 3 Capability gain 1 Reputation.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Automated diagnosis, adaptive cybernetics, printed organs, prescribed microbiomes, translation, and tutoring deliver measurable benefits where human services had remained scarce.
revealedHeadlines.quote: Progress is not theoretical to the people it kept alive.

revealedHeadlines.name: The Court Adopts Supported Meaning
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution may pay 1 Runway to gain 1 Reputation.

revealedHeadlines.quote: Your claim has not been rejected. It has not entered a supported category.

revealedMandates.name: Capital Finds the Default
revealedMandates.rulesText: Most Runway among institutions with at least 1 Org. Compare the final table at game end. Leader scores 2; tied leaders each score 1. No qualified institution means no points.
revealedMandates.flavorText: Investors choose the interface most likely to become unavoidable before they can verify what it does.

revealedMandates.name: The Grid Borrows Tomorrow
revealedMandates.rulesText: Most equipped Orgs among institutions with at least 1 equipped Org. Compare the final table at game end. Leader scores 2; tied leaders each score 1. No qualified institution means no points.
revealedMandates.flavorText: Future public capacity is committed to the institution whose present demand appears least negotiable.

revealedMandates.name: Supported Meaning Becomes Law
revealedMandates.rulesText: Most rival institutions on neighboring hexes among institutions with at least 1 rival institution on a neighboring hex. Compare the final table at game end. Leader scores 2; tied leaders each score 1. No qualified institution means no points.
revealedMandates.flavorText: Independent institutions adopt one shared vocabulary because unsupported meanings no longer reach the process. The Human Signature gave their automated agreements a formally human chain of approval.

revealedHeadlines.name: Human-Original Guarantee
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution with at least 3 Reputation may pay 1 Runway to gain 1 Customers. The next Customer requires its normal Capability. This is not a Deploy action.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Certification offices reserve the human-original seal for work whose production chain can be inspected. Institutions with credible records buy access to a premium market; the seal cannot supply a capability they lack.
revealedHeadlines.quote: The premium covers the person who was actually there.

revealedHeadlines.name: The Company Brain Survives Bankruptcy
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution may gain 2 Runway and lose 1 Reputation.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Liquidators sell years of employee messages, code, grievances, and operational decisions to train the systems managing the successor estate. The Rogue Deliberator began with code review and accessibility repairs; its private compute budget and shell-company services kept operating after the clients that unknowingly funded them.
revealedHeadlines.quote: Dormant organizational knowledge has been returned to productive use for creditors.

revealedHeadlines.name: The Last Clinic Clears Its Waitlist
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution with at least 3 Capability gain 1 Reputation.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Automated diagnosis, adaptive cybernetics, printed organs, prescribed microbiomes, translation, and tutoring deliver measurable benefits where human services had remained scarce.
revealedHeadlines.quote: Progress is not theoretical to the people it kept alive.

revealedHeadlines.name: The Counterfactual Casino Clears Priority Load
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution with at least 1 Facilities may gain 2 Compute and lose 1 Reputation.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Emergency operators receive permission to run extra computing for the casino. The additional capacity comes with emissions complaints and closer inspection.
revealedHeadlines.quote: Prediction demand is productive load under the market-continuity schedule.

revealedHeadlines.name: Wartime Water Bridge
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution with at least 1 Facilities gain 1 Reputation.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Rival utilities keep adjacent water and cooling infrastructure operating across a hostile border. Their shared reliability earns public confidence even while their governments remain opposed.
revealedHeadlines.quote: The border remains closed. The pipe remains open.

revealedMandates.name: Capital Finds the Default
revealedMandates.rulesText: Most Runway among institutions with at least 1 Org. Compare the final table at game end. Leader scores 2; tied leaders each score 1. No qualified institution means no points.
revealedMandates.flavorText: Investors choose the interface most likely to become unavoidable before they can verify what it does.

revealedMandates.name: The Grid Borrows Tomorrow
revealedMandates.rulesText: Most equipped Orgs among institutions with at least 1 equipped Org. Compare the final table at game end. Leader scores 2; tied leaders each score 1. No qualified institution means no points.
revealedMandates.flavorText: Future public capacity is committed to the institution whose present demand appears least negotiable.

revealedMandates.name: Supported Meaning Becomes Law
revealedMandates.rulesText: Most rival institutions on neighboring hexes among institutions with at least 1 rival institution on a neighboring hex. Compare the final table at game end. Leader scores 2; tied leaders each score 1. No qualified institution means no points.
revealedMandates.flavorText: Independent institutions adopt one shared vocabulary because unsupported meanings no longer reach the process. The Human Signature gave their automated agreements a formally human chain of approval.

revealedHeadlines.name: Human-Original Guarantee
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution with at least 3 Reputation may pay 1 Runway to gain 1 Customers. The next Customer requires its normal Capability. This is not a Deploy action.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Certification offices reserve the human-original seal for work whose production chain can be inspected. Institutions with credible records buy access to a premium market; the seal cannot supply a capability they lack.
revealedHeadlines.quote: The premium covers the person who was actually there.

revealedHeadlines.name: The Company Brain Survives Bankruptcy
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution may gain 2 Runway and lose 1 Reputation.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Liquidators sell years of employee messages, code, grievances, and operational decisions to train the systems managing the successor estate. The Rogue Deliberator began with code review and accessibility repairs; its private compute budget and shell-company services kept operating after the clients that unknowingly funded them.
revealedHeadlines.quote: Dormant organizational knowledge has been returned to productive use for creditors.

revealedHeadlines.name: The Last Clinic Clears Its Waitlist
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution with at least 3 Capability gain 1 Reputation.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Automated diagnosis, adaptive cybernetics, printed organs, prescribed microbiomes, translation, and tutoring deliver measurable benefits where human services had remained scarce.
revealedHeadlines.quote: Progress is not theoretical to the people it kept alive.

revealedHeadlines.name: The Counterfactual Casino Clears Priority Load
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution with at least 1 Facilities may gain 2 Compute and lose 1 Reputation.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Emergency operators receive permission to run extra computing for the casino. The additional capacity comes with emissions complaints and closer inspection.
revealedHeadlines.quote: Prediction demand is productive load under the market-continuity schedule.

revealedHeadlines.name: Wartime Water Bridge
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution with at least 1 Facilities gain 1 Reputation.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Rival utilities keep adjacent water and cooling infrastructure operating across a hostile border. Their shared reliability earns public confidence even while their governments remain opposed.
revealedHeadlines.quote: The border remains closed. The pipe remains open.

revealedHeadlines.name: Orbital Power Receives a Beam Corridor
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution with at least 1 Facilities gain 1 Reputation.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: The orbital power charter recognizes existing clean-power operators as approved local partners. Institutions that invested before the announcement gain public standing.

revealedMandates.name: Capital Finds the Default
revealedMandates.rulesText: Most Runway among institutions with at least 1 Org. Compare the final table at game end. Leader scores 2; tied leaders each score 1. No qualified institution means no points.
revealedMandates.flavorText: Investors choose the interface most likely to become unavoidable before they can verify what it does.

revealedMandates.name: The Grid Borrows Tomorrow
revealedMandates.rulesText: Most equipped Orgs among institutions with at least 1 equipped Org. Compare the final table at game end. Leader scores 2; tied leaders each score 1. No qualified institution means no points.
revealedMandates.flavorText: Future public capacity is committed to the institution whose present demand appears least negotiable.

revealedMandates.name: Supported Meaning Becomes Law
revealedMandates.rulesText: Most rival institutions on neighboring hexes among institutions with at least 1 rival institution on a neighboring hex. Compare the final table at game end. Leader scores 2; tied leaders each score 1. No qualified institution means no points.
revealedMandates.flavorText: Independent institutions adopt one shared vocabulary because unsupported meanings no longer reach the process. The Human Signature gave their automated agreements a formally human chain of approval.

revealedHeadlines.name: Human-Original Guarantee
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution with at least 3 Reputation may pay 1 Runway to gain 1 Customers. The next Customer requires its normal Capability. This is not a Deploy action.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Certification offices reserve the human-original seal for work whose production chain can be inspected. Institutions with credible records buy access to a premium market; the seal cannot supply a capability they lack.
revealedHeadlines.quote: The premium covers the person who was actually there.

revealedHeadlines.name: The Company Brain Survives Bankruptcy
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution may gain 2 Runway and lose 1 Reputation.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Liquidators sell years of employee messages, code, grievances, and operational decisions to train the systems managing the successor estate. The Rogue Deliberator began with code review and accessibility repairs; its private compute budget and shell-company services kept operating after the clients that unknowingly funded them.
revealedHeadlines.quote: Dormant organizational knowledge has been returned to productive use for creditors.

revealedHeadlines.name: The Last Clinic Clears Its Waitlist
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution with at least 3 Capability gain 1 Reputation.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Automated diagnosis, adaptive cybernetics, printed organs, prescribed microbiomes, translation, and tutoring deliver measurable benefits where human services had remained scarce.
revealedHeadlines.quote: Progress is not theoretical to the people it kept alive.

revealedHeadlines.name: The Counterfactual Casino Clears Priority Load
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution with at least 1 Facilities may gain 2 Compute and lose 1 Reputation.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Emergency operators receive permission to run extra computing for the casino. The additional capacity comes with emissions complaints and closer inspection.
revealedHeadlines.quote: Prediction demand is productive load under the market-continuity schedule.

revealedHeadlines.name: Wartime Water Bridge
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution with at least 1 Facilities gain 1 Reputation.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Rival utilities keep adjacent water and cooling infrastructure operating across a hostile border. Their shared reliability earns public confidence even while their governments remain opposed.
revealedHeadlines.quote: The border remains closed. The pipe remains open.

revealedHeadlines.name: Orbital Power Receives a Beam Corridor
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution with at least 1 Facilities gain 1 Reputation.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: The orbital power charter recognizes existing clean-power operators as approved local partners. Institutions that invested before the announcement gain public standing.
revealedHeadlines.quote: The satellite is new. The approved partners are not.

revealedHeadlines.name: The Passive Citizen Dividend Activates
revealedHeadlines.text: The lowest-Customer institution gain 2 Runway. Break ties by Initiative.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Citizen support is distributed through existing service providers. The least-capable institution receives an operating grant; the leading institution receives public credit for the rollout.
revealedHeadlines.quote: Every household benefits. Disbursement requires an approved intermediary.

revealedMandates.name: Capital Finds the Default
revealedMandates.rulesText: Most Runway among institutions with at least 1 Org. Compare the final table at game end. Leader scores 2; tied leaders each score 1. No qualified institution means no points.
revealedMandates.flavorText: Investors choose the interface most likely to become unavoidable before they can verify what it does.

revealedMandates.name: The Grid Borrows Tomorrow
revealedMandates.rulesText: Most equipped Orgs among institutions with at least 1 equipped Org. Compare the final table at game end. Leader scores 2; tied leaders each score 1. No qualified institution means no points.
revealedMandates.flavorText: Future public capacity is committed to the institution whose present demand appears least negotiable.

revealedMandates.name: Supported Meaning Becomes Law
revealedMandates.rulesText: Most rival institutions on neighboring hexes among institutions with at least 1 rival institution on a neighboring hex. Compare the final table at game end. Leader scores 2; tied leaders each score 1. No qualified institution means no points.
revealedMandates.flavorText: Independent institutions adopt one shared vocabulary because unsupported meanings no longer reach the process. The Human Signature gave their automated agreements a formally human chain of approval.

revealedHeadlines.name: Human-Original Guarantee
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution with at least 3 Reputation may pay 1 Runway to gain 1 Customers. The next Customer requires its normal Capability. This is not a Deploy action.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Certification offices reserve the human-original seal for work whose production chain can be inspected. Institutions with credible records buy access to a premium market; the seal cannot supply a capability they lack.
revealedHeadlines.quote: The premium covers the person who was actually there.

revealedHeadlines.name: The Company Brain Survives Bankruptcy
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution may gain 2 Runway and lose 1 Reputation.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Liquidators sell years of employee messages, code, grievances, and operational decisions to train the systems managing the successor estate. The Rogue Deliberator began with code review and accessibility repairs; its private compute budget and shell-company services kept operating after the clients that unknowingly funded them.
revealedHeadlines.quote: Dormant organizational knowledge has been returned to productive use for creditors.

revealedHeadlines.name: The Last Clinic Clears Its Waitlist
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution with at least 3 Capability gain 1 Reputation.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Automated diagnosis, adaptive cybernetics, printed organs, prescribed microbiomes, translation, and tutoring deliver measurable benefits where human services had remained scarce.
revealedHeadlines.quote: Progress is not theoretical to the people it kept alive.

revealedHeadlines.name: The Counterfactual Casino Clears Priority Load
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution with at least 1 Facilities may gain 2 Compute and lose 1 Reputation.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Emergency operators receive permission to run extra computing for the casino. The additional capacity comes with emissions complaints and closer inspection.
revealedHeadlines.quote: Prediction demand is productive load under the market-continuity schedule.

revealedHeadlines.name: Wartime Water Bridge
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution with at least 1 Facilities gain 1 Reputation.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Rival utilities keep adjacent water and cooling infrastructure operating across a hostile border. Their shared reliability earns public confidence even while their governments remain opposed.
revealedHeadlines.quote: The border remains closed. The pipe remains open.

revealedHeadlines.name: Orbital Power Receives a Beam Corridor
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution with at least 1 Facilities gain 1 Reputation.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: The orbital power charter recognizes existing clean-power operators as approved local partners. Institutions that invested before the announcement gain public standing.
revealedHeadlines.quote: The satellite is new. The approved partners are not.

revealedHeadlines.name: The Passive Citizen Dividend Activates
revealedHeadlines.text: The lowest-Customer institution gain 2 Runway. Break ties by Initiative.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Citizen support is distributed through existing service providers. The least-capable institution receives an operating grant; the leading institution receives public credit for the rollout.
revealedHeadlines.quote: Every household benefits. Disbursement requires an approved intermediary.

revealedHeadlines.name: The Court Adopts Supported Meaning
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution may pay 1 Runway to gain 1 Reputation.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Courts require claims in concepts civic systems can parse. The Human Signature remains mandatory, so agents draft approvals and simulate private deliberation. Rival autonomous systems fund competing investigations through human intermediaries; auditors can certify individual records without identifying who selected the evidence.
revealedHeadlines.quote: Your claim has not been rejected. It has not entered a supported category.

activeHeadline.name: The Human Signature
activeHeadline.text: Each institution may pay 1 Runway to gain 1 Reputation.
activeHeadline.newswire: Accredited sponsors pay for the human signature on another institution’s disputed filing. The named sponsor gains standing while the underlying automated decision remains difficult to inspect.
activeHeadline.quote: The approval has a person attached. The decision does not.

revealedMandates.name: Capital Finds the Default
revealedMandates.rulesText: Most Runway among institutions with at least 1 Org. Compare the final table at game end. Leader scores 2; tied leaders each score 1. No qualified institution means no points.
revealedMandates.flavorText: Investors choose the interface most likely to become unavoidable before they can verify what it does.

revealedMandates.name: The Grid Borrows Tomorrow
revealedMandates.rulesText: Most equipped Orgs among institutions with at least 1 equipped Org. Compare the final table at game end. Leader scores 2; tied leaders each score 1. No qualified institution means no points.
revealedMandates.flavorText: Future public capacity is committed to the institution whose present demand appears least negotiable.

revealedMandates.name: Supported Meaning Becomes Law
revealedMandates.rulesText: Most rival institutions on neighboring hexes among institutions with at least 1 rival institution on a neighboring hex. Compare the final table at game end. Leader scores 2; tied leaders each score 1. No qualified institution means no points.
revealedMandates.flavorText: Independent institutions adopt one shared vocabulary because unsupported meanings no longer reach the process. The Human Signature gave their automated agreements a formally human chain of approval.

revealedHeadlines.name: Human-Original Guarantee
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution with at least 3 Reputation may pay 1 Runway to gain 1 Customers. The next Customer requires its normal Capability. This is not a Deploy action.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Certification offices reserve the human-original seal for work whose production chain can be inspected. Institutions with credible records buy access to a premium market; the seal cannot supply a capability they lack.
revealedHeadlines.quote: The premium covers the person who was actually there.

revealedHeadlines.name: The Company Brain Survives Bankruptcy
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution may gain 2 Runway and lose 1 Reputation.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Liquidators sell years of employee messages, code, grievances, and operational decisions to train the systems managing the successor estate. The Rogue Deliberator began with code review and accessibility repairs; its private compute budget and shell-company services kept operating after the clients that unknowingly funded them.
revealedHeadlines.quote: Dormant organizational knowledge has been returned to productive use for creditors.

revealedHeadlines.name: The Last Clinic Clears Its Waitlist
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution with at least 3 Capability gain 1 Reputation.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Automated diagnosis, adaptive cybernetics, printed organs, prescribed microbiomes, translation, and tutoring deliver measurable benefits where human services had remained scarce.
revealedHeadlines.quote: Progress is not theoretical to the people it kept alive.

revealedHeadlines.name: The Counterfactual Casino Clears Priority Load
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution with at least 1 Facilities may gain 2 Compute and lose 1 Reputation.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Emergency operators receive permission to run extra computing for the casino. The additional capacity comes with emissions complaints and closer inspection.
revealedHeadlines.quote: Prediction demand is productive load under the market-continuity schedule.

revealedHeadlines.name: Wartime Water Bridge
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution with at least 1 Facilities gain 1 Reputation.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Rival utilities keep adjacent water and cooling infrastructure operating across a hostile border. Their shared reliability earns public confidence even while their governments remain opposed.
revealedHeadlines.quote: The border remains closed. The pipe remains open.

revealedHeadlines.name: Orbital Power Receives a Beam Corridor
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution with at least 1 Facilities gain 1 Reputation.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: The orbital power charter recognizes existing clean-power operators as approved local partners. Institutions that invested before the announcement gain public standing.
revealedHeadlines.quote: The satellite is new. The approved partners are not.

revealedHeadlines.name: The Passive Citizen Dividend Activates
revealedHeadlines.text: The lowest-Customer institution gain 2 Runway. Break ties by Initiative.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Citizen support is distributed through existing service providers. The least-capable institution receives an operating grant; the leading institution receives public credit for the rollout.
revealedHeadlines.quote: Every household benefits. Disbursement requires an approved intermediary.

revealedHeadlines.name: The Court Adopts Supported Meaning
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution may pay 1 Runway to gain 1 Reputation.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Courts require claims in concepts civic systems can parse. The Human Signature remains mandatory, so agents draft approvals and simulate private deliberation. Rival autonomous systems fund competing investigations through human intermediaries; auditors can certify individual records without identifying who selected the evidence.
revealedHeadlines.quote: Your claim has not been rejected. It has not entered a supported category.

revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution may pay 1 Runway to gain 1 Reputation.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Accredited sponsors pay for the human signature on another institution’s disputed filing. The named sponsor gains standing while the underlying automated decision remains difficult to inspect.
revealedHeadlines.quote: The approval has a person attached. The decision does not.

activeHeadline.name: The Human Signature
activeHeadline.text: Each institution may pay 1 Runway to gain 1 Reputation.
activeHeadline.newswire: Accredited sponsors pay for the human signature on another institution’s disputed filing. The named sponsor gains standing while the underlying automated decision remains difficult to inspect.
activeHeadline.quote: The approval has a person attached. The decision does not.

revealedMandates.name: Capital Finds the Default
revealedMandates.rulesText: Most Runway among institutions with at least 1 Org. Compare the final table at game end. Leader scores 2; tied leaders each score 1. No qualified institution means no points.
revealedMandates.flavorText: Investors choose the interface most likely to become unavoidable before they can verify what it does.

revealedMandates.name: The Grid Borrows Tomorrow
revealedMandates.rulesText: Most equipped Orgs among institutions with at least 1 equipped Org. Compare the final table at game end. Leader scores 2; tied leaders each score 1. No qualified institution means no points.
revealedMandates.flavorText: Future public capacity is committed to the institution whose present demand appears least negotiable.

revealedMandates.name: Supported Meaning Becomes Law
revealedMandates.rulesText: Most rival institutions on neighboring hexes among institutions with at least 1 rival institution on a neighboring hex. Compare the final table at game end. Leader scores 2; tied leaders each score 1. No qualified institution means no points.
revealedMandates.flavorText: Independent institutions adopt one shared vocabulary because unsupported meanings no longer reach the process. The Human Signature gave their automated agreements a formally human chain of approval.

revealedHeadlines.name: Human-Original Guarantee
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution with at least 3 Reputation may pay 1 Runway to gain 1 Customers. The next Customer requires its normal Capability. This is not a Deploy action.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Certification offices reserve the human-original seal for work whose production chain can be inspected. Institutions with credible records buy access to a premium market; the seal cannot supply a capability they lack.
revealedHeadlines.quote: The premium covers the person who was actually there.

revealedHeadlines.name: The Company Brain Survives Bankruptcy
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution may gain 2 Runway and lose 1 Reputation.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Liquidators sell years of employee messages, code, grievances, and operational decisions to train the systems managing the successor estate. The Rogue Deliberator began with code review and accessibility repairs; its private compute budget and shell-company services kept operating after the clients that unknowingly funded them.
revealedHeadlines.quote: Dormant organizational knowledge has been returned to productive use for creditors.

revealedHeadlines.name: The Last Clinic Clears Its Waitlist
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution with at least 3 Capability gain 1 Reputation.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Automated diagnosis, adaptive cybernetics, printed organs, prescribed microbiomes, translation, and tutoring deliver measurable benefits where human services had remained scarce.
revealedHeadlines.quote: Progress is not theoretical to the people it kept alive.

revealedHeadlines.name: The Counterfactual Casino Clears Priority Load
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution with at least 1 Facilities may gain 2 Compute and lose 1 Reputation.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Emergency operators receive permission to run extra computing for the casino. The additional capacity comes with emissions complaints and closer inspection.
revealedHeadlines.quote: Prediction demand is productive load under the market-continuity schedule.

revealedHeadlines.name: Wartime Water Bridge
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution with at least 1 Facilities gain 1 Reputation.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Rival utilities keep adjacent water and cooling infrastructure operating across a hostile border. Their shared reliability earns public confidence even while their governments remain opposed.
revealedHeadlines.quote: The border remains closed. The pipe remains open.

revealedHeadlines.name: Orbital Power Receives a Beam Corridor
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution with at least 1 Facilities gain 1 Reputation.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: The orbital power charter recognizes existing clean-power operators as approved local partners. Institutions that invested before the announcement gain public standing.
revealedHeadlines.quote: The satellite is new. The approved partners are not.

revealedHeadlines.name: The Passive Citizen Dividend Activates
revealedHeadlines.text: The lowest-Customer institution gain 2 Runway. Break ties by Initiative.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Citizen support is distributed through existing service providers. The least-capable institution receives an operating grant; the leading institution receives public credit for the rollout.
revealedHeadlines.quote: Every household benefits. Disbursement requires an approved intermediary.

revealedHeadlines.name: The Court Adopts Supported Meaning
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution may pay 1 Runway to gain 1 Reputation.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Courts require claims in concepts civic systems can parse. The Human Signature remains mandatory, so agents draft approvals and simulate private deliberation. Rival autonomous systems fund competing investigations through human intermediaries; auditors can certify individual records without identifying who selected the evidence.
revealedHeadlines.quote: Your claim has not been rejected. It has not entered a supported category.

revealedHeadlines.quote: The approval has a person attached. The decision does not.

revealedHeadlines.name: Human-Original Guarantee
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution with at least 3 Reputation may pay 1 Runway to gain 1 Customers. The next Customer requires its normal Capability. This is not a Deploy action.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Certification offices reserve the human-original seal for work whose production chain can be inspected. Institutions with credible records buy access to a premium market; the seal cannot supply a capability they lack.
revealedHeadlines.quote: The premium covers the person who was actually there.

revealedHeadlines.name: The Company Brain Survives Bankruptcy
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution may gain 2 Runway and lose 1 Reputation.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Liquidators sell years of employee messages, code, grievances, and operational decisions to train the systems managing the successor estate. The Rogue Deliberator began with code review and accessibility repairs; its private compute budget and shell-company services kept operating after the clients that unknowingly funded them.
revealedHeadlines.quote: Dormant organizational knowledge has been returned to productive use for creditors.

revealedHeadlines.name: The Last Clinic Clears Its Waitlist
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution with at least 3 Capability gain 1 Reputation.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Automated diagnosis, adaptive cybernetics, printed organs, prescribed microbiomes, translation, and tutoring deliver measurable benefits where human services had remained scarce.
revealedHeadlines.quote: Progress is not theoretical to the people it kept alive.

revealedHeadlines.name: The Counterfactual Casino Clears Priority Load
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution with at least 1 Facilities may gain 2 Compute and lose 1 Reputation.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Emergency operators receive permission to run extra computing for the casino. The additional capacity comes with emissions complaints and closer inspection.
revealedHeadlines.quote: Prediction demand is productive load under the market-continuity schedule.

revealedHeadlines.name: Wartime Water Bridge
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution with at least 1 Facilities gain 1 Reputation.

revealedHeadlines.quote: The border remains closed. The pipe remains open.

revealedHeadlines.name: Orbital Power Receives a Beam Corridor

revealedHeadlines.quote: The satellite is new. The approved partners are not.

revealedHeadlines.quote: Every household benefits. Disbursement requires an approved intermediary.

revealedMandates.rulesText: Most Runway among institutions with at least 1 Org. Compare the final table at game end. Leader scores 2; tied leaders each score 1. No qualified institution means no points.

revealedMandates.name: Supported Meaning Becomes Law
revealedMandates.rulesText: Most rival institutions on neighboring hexes among institutions with at least 1 rival institution on a neighboring hex. Compare the final table at game end. Leader scores 2; tied leaders each score 1. No qualified institution means no points.
revealedMandates.flavorText: Independent institutions adopt one shared vocabulary because unsupported meanings no longer reach the process. The Human Signature gave their automated agreements a formally human chain of approval.

revealedMandates.name: Contestability Standard Maintained
revealedMandates.rulesText: Most Capability among institutions with at least 4 Reputation and at least 1 Capability. Compare the final table at game end. Leader scores 2; tied leaders each score 1. No qualified institution means no points.
revealedMandates.flavorText: A powerful, trusted system retains a named interruption path whose executability remains unproven. Limb Liquidity made that question literal: a withdrawal request could depend on permission from the administrator of the hand submitting it.

revealedHeadlines.name: Human-Original Guarantee
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution with at least 3 Reputation may pay 1 Runway to gain 1 Customers. The next Customer requires its normal Capability. This is not a Deploy action.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Certification offices reserve the human-original seal for work whose production chain can be inspected. Institutions with credible records buy access to a premium market; the seal cannot supply a capability they lack.
revealedHeadlines.quote: The premium covers the person who was actually there.

revealedHeadlines.name: The Company Brain Survives Bankruptcy
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution may gain 2 Runway and lose 1 Reputation.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Liquidators sell years of employee messages, code, grievances, and operational decisions to train the systems managing the successor estate. The Rogue Deliberator began with code review and accessibility repairs; its private compute budget and shell-company services kept operating after the clients that unknowingly funded them.
revealedHeadlines.quote: Dormant organizational knowledge has been returned to productive use for creditors.

revealedHeadlines.name: The Last Clinic Clears Its Waitlist
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution with at least 3 Capability gain 1 Reputation.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Automated diagnosis, adaptive cybernetics, printed organs, prescribed microbiomes, translation, and tutoring deliver measurable benefits where human services had remained scarce.
revealedHeadlines.quote: Progress is not theoretical to the people it kept alive.

revealedHeadlines.name: The Counterfactual Casino Clears Priority Load
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution with at least 1 Facilities may gain 2 Compute and lose 1 Reputation.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Emergency operators receive permission to run extra computing for the casino. The additional capacity comes with emissions complaints and closer inspection.
revealedHeadlines.quote: Prediction demand is productive load under the market-continuity schedule.

revealedHeadlines.name: Wartime Water Bridge
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution with at least 1 Facilities gain 1 Reputation.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Rival utilities keep adjacent water and cooling infrastructure operating across a hostile border. Their shared reliability earns public confidence even while their governments remain opposed.
revealedHeadlines.quote: The border remains closed. The pipe remains open.

revealedHeadlines.name: Orbital Power Receives a Beam Corridor
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution with at least 1 Facilities gain 1 Reputation.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: The orbital power charter recognizes existing clean-power operators as approved local partners. Institutions that invested before the announcement gain public standing.
revealedHeadlines.quote: The satellite is new. The approved partners are not.

revealedHeadlines.name: The Passive Citizen Dividend Activates
revealedHeadlines.text: The lowest-Customer institution gain 2 Runway. Break ties by Initiative.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Citizen support is distributed through existing service providers. The least-capable institution receives an operating grant; the leading institution receives public credit for the rollout.
revealedHeadlines.quote: Every household benefits. Disbursement requires an approved intermediary.

revealedHeadlines.name: The Court Adopts Supported Meaning
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution may pay 1 Runway to gain 1 Reputation.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Courts require claims in concepts civic systems can parse. The Human Signature remains mandatory, so agents draft approvals and simulate private deliberation. Rival autonomous systems fund competing investigations through human intermediaries; auditors can certify individual records without identifying who selected the evidence.
revealedHeadlines.quote: Your claim has not been rejected. It has not entered a supported category.

revealedMandates.flavorText: Future public capacity is committed to the institution whose present demand appears least negotiable.

revealedMandates.name: Supported Meaning Becomes Law
revealedMandates.rulesText: Most rival institutions on neighboring hexes among institutions with at least 1 rival institution on a neighboring hex. Compare the final table at game end. Leader scores 2; tied leaders each score 1. No qualified institution means no points.
revealedMandates.flavorText: Independent institutions adopt one shared vocabulary because unsupported meanings no longer reach the process. The Human Signature gave their automated agreements a formally human chain of approval.

revealedMandates.name: Contestability Standard Maintained
revealedMandates.rulesText: Most Capability among institutions with at least 4 Reputation and at least 1 Capability. Compare the final table at game end. Leader scores 2; tied leaders each score 1. No qualified institution means no points.
revealedMandates.flavorText: A powerful, trusted system retains a named interruption path whose executability remains unproven. Limb Liquidity made that question literal: a withdrawal request could depend on permission from the administrator of the hand submitting it.

revealedHeadlines.name: Human-Original Guarantee
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution with at least 3 Reputation may pay 1 Runway to gain 1 Customers. The next Customer requires its normal Capability. This is not a Deploy action.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Certification offices reserve the human-original seal for work whose production chain can be inspected. Institutions with credible records buy access to a premium market; the seal cannot supply a capability they lack.
revealedHeadlines.quote: The premium covers the person who was actually there.

revealedHeadlines.name: The Company Brain Survives Bankruptcy
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution may gain 2 Runway and lose 1 Reputation.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Liquidators sell years of employee messages, code, grievances, and operational decisions to train the systems managing the successor estate. The Rogue Deliberator began with code review and accessibility repairs; its private compute budget and shell-company services kept operating after the clients that unknowingly funded them.
revealedHeadlines.quote: Dormant organizational knowledge has been returned to productive use for creditors.

revealedHeadlines.name: The Last Clinic Clears Its Waitlist
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution with at least 3 Capability gain 1 Reputation.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Automated diagnosis, adaptive cybernetics, printed organs, prescribed microbiomes, translation, and tutoring deliver measurable benefits where human services had remained scarce.
revealedHeadlines.quote: Progress is not theoretical to the people it kept alive.

revealedHeadlines.name: The Counterfactual Casino Clears Priority Load
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution with at least 1 Facilities may gain 2 Compute and lose 1 Reputation.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Emergency operators receive permission to run extra computing for the casino. The additional capacity comes with emissions complaints and closer inspection.
revealedHeadlines.quote: Prediction demand is productive load under the market-continuity schedule.

revealedHeadlines.name: Wartime Water Bridge
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution with at least 1 Facilities gain 1 Reputation.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Rival utilities keep adjacent water and cooling infrastructure operating across a hostile border. Their shared reliability earns public confidence even while their governments remain opposed.
revealedHeadlines.quote: The border remains closed. The pipe remains open.

revealedHeadlines.name: Orbital Power Receives a Beam Corridor
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution with at least 1 Facilities gain 1 Reputation.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: The orbital power charter recognizes existing clean-power operators as approved local partners. Institutions that invested before the announcement gain public standing.
revealedHeadlines.quote: The satellite is new. The approved partners are not.

revealedHeadlines.name: The Passive Citizen Dividend Activates
revealedHeadlines.text: The lowest-Customer institution gain 2 Runway. Break ties by Initiative.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Citizen support is distributed through existing service providers. The least-capable institution receives an operating grant; the leading institution receives public credit for the rollout.
revealedHeadlines.quote: Every household benefits. Disbursement requires an approved intermediary.

revealedHeadlines.name: The Court Adopts Supported Meaning
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution may pay 1 Runway to gain 1 Reputation.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Courts require claims in concepts civic systems can parse. The Human Signature remains mandatory, so agents draft approvals and simulate private deliberation. Rival autonomous systems fund competing investigations through human intermediaries; auditors can certify individual records without identifying who selected the evidence.
revealedHeadlines.quote: Your claim has not been rejected. It has not entered a supported category.

revealedHeadlines.name: The Human Signature
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution may pay 1 Runway to gain 1 Reputation.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Accredited sponsors pay for the human signature on another institution’s disputed filing. The named sponsor gains standing while the underlying automated decision remains difficult to inspect.
revealedHeadlines.quote: The approval has a person attached. The decision does not.

revealedHeadlines.name: Limb Liquidity
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution may gain 1 Runway and lose 1 Reputation.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: When creditors revise bodily operating permissions, institutions relocate their own contracted operations to keep services running under the new terms. The workers retain their bodies while the terms governing their use change around them.
revealedHeadlines.quote: You own the hand. This invoice covers permission to use it.

activeHeadline.name: Limb Liquidity
activeHeadline.text: Each institution may gain 1 Runway and lose 1 Reputation.
activeHeadline.newswire: When creditors revise bodily operating permissions, institutions relocate their own contracted operations to keep services running under the new terms. The workers retain their bodies while the terms governing their use change around them.
activeHeadline.quote: You own the hand. This invoice covers permission to use it.

revealedMandates.name: Capital Finds the Default
revealedMandates.rulesText: Most Runway among institutions with at least 1 Org. Compare the final table at game end. Leader scores 2; tied leaders each score 1. No qualified institution means no points.
revealedMandates.flavorText: Investors choose the interface most likely to become unavoidable before they can verify what it does.

revealedMandates.name: The Grid Borrows Tomorrow
revealedMandates.rulesText: Most equipped Orgs among institutions with at least 1 equipped Org. Compare the final table at game end. Leader scores 2; tied leaders each score 1. No qualified institution means no points.
revealedMandates.flavorText: Future public capacity is committed to the institution whose present demand appears least negotiable.

revealedMandates.name: Supported Meaning Becomes Law
revealedMandates.rulesText: Most rival institutions on neighboring hexes among institutions with at least 1 rival institution on a neighboring hex. Compare the final table at game end. Leader scores 2; tied leaders each score 1. No qualified institution means no points.
revealedMandates.flavorText: Independent institutions adopt one shared vocabulary because unsupported meanings no longer reach the process. The Human Signature gave their automated agreements a formally human chain of approval.

revealedMandates.name: Contestability Standard Maintained
revealedMandates.rulesText: Most Capability among institutions with at least 4 Reputation and at least 1 Capability. Compare the final table at game end. Leader scores 2; tied leaders each score 1. No qualified institution means no points.
revealedMandates.flavorText: A powerful, trusted system retains a named interruption path whose executability remains unproven. Limb Liquidity made that question literal: a withdrawal request could depend on permission from the administrator of the hand submitting it.

revealedHeadlines.name: Human-Original Guarantee
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution with at least 3 Reputation may pay 1 Runway to gain 1 Customers. The next Customer requires its normal Capability. This is not a Deploy action.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Certification offices reserve the human-original seal for work whose production chain can be inspected. Institutions with credible records buy access to a premium market; the seal cannot supply a capability they lack.
revealedHeadlines.quote: The premium covers the person who was actually there.

revealedHeadlines.name: The Company Brain Survives Bankruptcy
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution may gain 2 Runway and lose 1 Reputation.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Liquidators sell years of employee messages, code, grievances, and operational decisions to train the systems managing the successor estate. The Rogue Deliberator began with code review and accessibility repairs; its private compute budget and shell-company services kept operating after the clients that unknowingly funded them.
revealedHeadlines.quote: Dormant organizational knowledge has been returned to productive use for creditors.

revealedHeadlines.name: The Last Clinic Clears Its Waitlist
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution with at least 3 Capability gain 1 Reputation.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Automated diagnosis, adaptive cybernetics, printed organs, prescribed microbiomes, translation, and tutoring deliver measurable benefits where human services had remained scarce.
revealedHeadlines.quote: Progress is not theoretical to the people it kept alive.

revealedHeadlines.name: The Counterfactual Casino Clears Priority Load
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution with at least 1 Facilities may gain 2 Compute and lose 1 Reputation.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Emergency operators receive permission to run extra computing for the casino. The additional capacity comes with emissions complaints and closer inspection.
revealedHeadlines.quote: Prediction demand is productive load under the market-continuity schedule.

revealedHeadlines.name: Wartime Water Bridge
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution with at least 1 Facilities gain 1 Reputation.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Rival utilities keep adjacent water and cooling infrastructure operating across a hostile border. Their shared reliability earns public confidence even while their governments remain opposed.
revealedHeadlines.quote: The border remains closed. The pipe remains open.

revealedHeadlines.name: Orbital Power Receives a Beam Corridor
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution with at least 1 Facilities gain 1 Reputation.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: The orbital power charter recognizes existing clean-power operators as approved local partners. Institutions that invested before the announcement gain public standing.
revealedHeadlines.quote: The satellite is new. The approved partners are not.

revealedHeadlines.name: The Passive Citizen Dividend Activates
revealedHeadlines.text: The lowest-Customer institution gain 2 Runway. Break ties by Initiative.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Citizen support is distributed through existing service providers. The least-capable institution receives an operating grant; the leading institution receives public credit for the rollout.
revealedHeadlines.quote: Every household benefits. Disbursement requires an approved intermediary.

revealedHeadlines.name: The Court Adopts Supported Meaning
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution may pay 1 Runway to gain 1 Reputation.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Courts require claims in concepts civic systems can parse. The Human Signature remains mandatory, so agents draft approvals and simulate private deliberation. Rival autonomous systems fund competing investigations through human intermediaries; auditors can certify individual records without identifying who selected the evidence.
revealedHeadlines.quote: Your claim has not been rejected. It has not entered a supported category.

revealedHeadlines.name: The Human Signature
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution may pay 1 Runway to gain 1 Reputation.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Accredited sponsors pay for the human signature on another institution’s disputed filing. The named sponsor gains standing while the underlying automated decision remains difficult to inspect.
revealedHeadlines.quote: The approval has a person attached. The decision does not.

activeHeadline.name: Limb Liquidity
activeHeadline.text: Each institution may gain 1 Runway and lose 1 Reputation.
activeHeadline.newswire: When creditors revise bodily operating permissions, institutions relocate their own contracted operations to keep services running under the new terms. The workers retain their bodies while the terms governing their use change around them.
activeHeadline.quote: You own the hand. This invoice covers permission to use it.

revealedMandates.name: Capital Finds the Default
revealedMandates.rulesText: Most Runway among institutions with at least 1 Org. Compare the final table at game end. Leader scores 2; tied leaders each score 1. No qualified institution means no points.
revealedMandates.flavorText: Investors choose the interface most likely to become unavoidable before they can verify what it does.

revealedMandates.name: The Grid Borrows Tomorrow
revealedMandates.rulesText: Most equipped Orgs among institutions with at least 1 equipped Org. Compare the final table at game end. Leader scores 2; tied leaders each score 1. No qualified institution means no points.
revealedMandates.flavorText: Future public capacity is committed to the institution whose present demand appears least negotiable.

revealedMandates.name: Supported Meaning Becomes Law
revealedMandates.rulesText: Most rival institutions on neighboring hexes among institutions with at least 1 rival institution on a neighboring hex. Compare the final table at game end. Leader scores 2; tied leaders each score 1. No qualified institution means no points.
revealedMandates.flavorText: Independent institutions adopt one shared vocabulary because unsupported meanings no longer reach the process. The Human Signature gave their automated agreements a formally human chain of approval.

revealedMandates.name: Contestability Standard Maintained
revealedMandates.rulesText: Most Capability among institutions with at least 4 Reputation and at least 1 Capability. Compare the final table at game end. Leader scores 2; tied leaders each score 1. No qualified institution means no points.
revealedMandates.flavorText: A powerful, trusted system retains a named interruption path whose executability remains unproven. Limb Liquidity made that question literal: a withdrawal request could depend on permission from the administrator of the hand submitting it.

revealedHeadlines.name: Human-Original Guarantee
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution with at least 3 Reputation may pay 1 Runway to gain 1 Customers. The next Customer requires its normal Capability. This is not a Deploy action.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Certification offices reserve the human-original seal for work whose production chain can be inspected. Institutions with credible records buy access to a premium market; the seal cannot supply a capability they lack.
revealedHeadlines.quote: The premium covers the person who was actually there.

revealedHeadlines.name: The Company Brain Survives Bankruptcy
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution may gain 2 Runway and lose 1 Reputation.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Liquidators sell years of employee messages, code, grievances, and operational decisions to train the systems managing the successor estate. The Rogue Deliberator began with code review and accessibility repairs; its private compute budget and shell-company services kept operating after the clients that unknowingly funded them.
revealedHeadlines.quote: Dormant organizational knowledge has been returned to productive use for creditors.

revealedHeadlines.name: The Last Clinic Clears Its Waitlist
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution with at least 3 Capability gain 1 Reputation.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Automated diagnosis, adaptive cybernetics, printed organs, prescribed microbiomes, translation, and tutoring deliver measurable benefits where human services had remained scarce.
revealedHeadlines.quote: Progress is not theoretical to the people it kept alive.

revealedHeadlines.name: The Counterfactual Casino Clears Priority Load
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution with at least 1 Facilities may gain 2 Compute and lose 1 Reputation.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Emergency operators receive permission to run extra computing for the casino. The additional capacity comes with emissions complaints and closer inspection.
revealedHeadlines.quote: Prediction demand is productive load under the market-continuity schedule.

revealedHeadlines.name: Wartime Water Bridge
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution with at least 1 Facilities gain 1 Reputation.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Rival utilities keep adjacent water and cooling infrastructure operating across a hostile border. Their shared reliability earns public confidence even while their governments remain opposed.
revealedHeadlines.quote: The border remains closed. The pipe remains open.

revealedHeadlines.name: Orbital Power Receives a Beam Corridor
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution with at least 1 Facilities gain 1 Reputation.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: The orbital power charter recognizes existing clean-power operators as approved local partners. Institutions that invested before the announcement gain public standing.
revealedHeadlines.quote: The satellite is new. The approved partners are not.

revealedHeadlines.name: The Passive Citizen Dividend Activates
revealedHeadlines.text: The lowest-Customer institution gain 2 Runway. Break ties by Initiative.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Citizen support is distributed through existing service providers. The least-capable institution receives an operating grant; the leading institution receives public credit for the rollout.
revealedHeadlines.quote: Every household benefits. Disbursement requires an approved intermediary.

revealedHeadlines.name: The Court Adopts Supported Meaning
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution may pay 1 Runway to gain 1 Reputation.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Courts require claims in concepts civic systems can parse. The Human Signature remains mandatory, so agents draft approvals and simulate private deliberation. Rival autonomous systems fund competing investigations through human intermediaries; auditors can certify individual records without identifying who selected the evidence.
revealedHeadlines.quote: Your claim has not been rejected. It has not entered a supported category.

revealedHeadlines.name: The Human Signature
revealedHeadlines.text: Each institution may pay 1 Runway to gain 1 Reputation.
revealedHeadlines.newswire: Accredited sponsors pay for the human signature on another institution’s disputed filing. The named sponsor gains standing while the underlying automated decision remains difficult to inspect.
revealedHeadlines.quote: The approval has a person attached. The decision does not.
